q: How do I count emissions from handling at a container freight station?
title: Container freight station emissions
short: A container freight station burns diesel in reach stackers, forklifts and trucks and uses power for lights and offices. For the station that is Scope 1 and 2. For a shipper, the handling is part of transport and distribution, Category 4 or 9.

ul: Diesel per month from fuel slips.
Container moves per month, in TEU.
Diesel divided by TEU gives a figure per move.

p: Ask the station for a figure per TEU, or estimate from its moves. The GLEC Framework counts logistics sites alongside transport legs.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
